name: A Sticky Situation
summary: Dran Droffers seeks the original packaging for Hinterlands Honey Ripple. Gilveradin Sunchaser has it and asks for two extra bottles; ten bottles wait in crates around the abandoned Horde base near Skulk Rock.

sections.title: A Matter of Packaging
sections.body: Dran Droffers seeks Hinterlands Honey Ripple, and Gilveradin Sunchaser has its original packaging. Gilveradin offers to help in return for two extra bottles. Gather ten bottles and bring them back to the camp.

sections.title: Ruins of Skulk Rock
sections.body: Crates of Hinterlands Honey Ripple are scattered around the abandoned Horde base near Skulk Rock. Foul slimes and oozes cling to the ruins. Rumor says a master ooze leads them.

faq.q: Who wants the Hinterlands Honey Ripple packaged?
faq.answer: Dran Droffers seeks Hinterlands Honey Ripple. Gilveradin Sunchaser has its original packaging, meant for Malton's father.

faq.q: What does Gilveradin charge for the packaging?
faq.answer: Gilveradin asks for two extra bottles of the ripple as his fee. Ten bottles are in the crates.

faq.q: Where are the crates of Hinterlands Honey Ripple kept?
faq.answer: The crates are around the abandoned Horde base near Skulk Rock in the Hinterlands.

faq.q: What is at the abandoned camp at Skulk Rock?
faq.answer: Foul slimes and oozes cling to the ruins, and rumor says a master ooze leads them.
